comments.author: foodstampz313
comments.body_html:
⚠️ IMPORTANT: If the mod archive will not open with the default Windows extractor, please use WinRAR or 7-Zip instead.

Some users have reported that Windows’ built-in unzip tool fails to properly open the file, while WinRAR/7-Zip works without issues.

The mod itself is not corrupted — this appears to be a compatibility issue with the Windows archive tool.

Recommended: • WinRAR • 7-Zip

Sorry for the inconvenience, and thanks to everyone who reported the issue so I could look into it.

Also, thank you all for the support — we’re already approaching 400 downloads which is honestly awesome to see. — foodstampz
